newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian central bank gold reserves up to 400 T.
newsitem.headline: Russian central bank gold reserves up to 400 T.

text.p: Russia's central bank bought about 100 tonnes of gold in 1996, boosting its reserves to around 400 tonnes, the bank's precious metals department chief, Sergei Kyshtymov, told Reuters on Tuesday.
Russia's gold output for 1996 is forecast to slip to 110 tonnes from 122 tonnes in 1995 and 132 tonnes in 1994.

The central bank says it plans to liberalise the domestic gold market to channel commercial bank funds into output, but the necessary laws have yet to be passed, including measures that would allow banks to export gold freely.
